events.title: Open Court - Basketball | Jumpstart Multi Sport Court
events.description:
Check out the Jumpstart Multi Sport Court at Panorama! Free, accessible, recreational play for all ages. 

Space includes 8 basketball nets (2 adjustable), a convertible net (set to high or low height dependent on the day), picnic tables and a free play space. Sun shades are hung seasonally. Lines and nets are recreational; not regulation.

Bring or borrow equipment. Equipment may be signed out at Reception (available first come, first served).

Please limit play to 30 minutes if others are waiting. 

Code of Conduct:  Users are expected to be welcoming, inclusive and sportsmanlike. Panorama Recreation promotes a safe, welcoming, positive and inclusive environment where everyone is valued and respected. Staff, volunteers, participants and facility users are expected to be considerate, respectful of others, and take proper care for our facility and equipment.

Check out the Jumpstart Multi Sport Court at Panorama! Free, accessible, recreational play for all ages. 

Space includes 8 basketball nets (2 adjustable), a convertible net (set to high or low height dependent on the day), picnic tables and a free play space. Sun shades are hung seasonally. Lines and nets are recreational; not regulation.

Bring or borrow equipment. Equipment may be signed out at Reception (available first come, first served).

Please limit play to 30 minutes if others are waiting. 

Code of Conduct:  Users are expected to be welcoming, inclusive and sportsmanlike. Panorama Recreation promotes a safe, welcoming, positive and inclusive environment where everyone is valued and respected. Staff, volunteers, participants and facility users are expected to be considerate, respectful of others, and take proper care for our facility and equipment.

events.title: Buddhist Meditation *Hybrid Drop-in
events.description:
Introduction to Buddhist Meditation (Sep15-Oct 27)  *Hybrid Drop-in ($15 per class)
Instructor: Canadian Buddhist Monk, Gen Kelsang Zopa
In today’s fast-paced and often overwhelming world, finding a sense of inner peace and refuge can feel out of reach. Learning how to develop and maintain a peaceful mind is the very essence of Buddhist meditation. We discover that both happiness and suffering mainly arise from our mental habits, and learn to experience the healing insights of Buddhist meditation in our daily life.

Buddhist Meditation for a Loving Heart (Nov 3-Dec 15) *Hybrid Drop-in ($15 per class)
Instructor: Canadian Buddhist Monk, Gen Kelsang Zopa
We all long for more positive and joyful relationships with others, free of tension and stress. In this course we will explore Buddha’s teachings on how to develop a patient, kind and accepting attitude towards everyone we meet. By letting go of our tendency to see faults in others and developing equanimity, we will find meaning and joy in all our relationships.

events.title: Play Beyond Expectations
events.description:
Run by Lifetime Networks - Play Beyond Expectations provides adults with developmental disabilities an opportunity to access inclusive, community-based recreation in an open gym format. This group is  a fun and relaxed opportunity to learn different sports and social skills in an environment that welcomes young adults of all levels of functioning ability. Previous experience with sports is not required. This program focusses on enjoyable skill games based on floor hockey, basketball, pickleball and group games tailored to each person’s abilities.

Players and volunteers all enjoy the accepting and encouraging atmosphere. The lead volunteers are themselves people who have overcome physical challenges to find success in sports and in life. The improved physical activity, coordination, and cooperation skills gained in the gym transfer to greater success in other activities at home and in the community. Each participant is recognized for their best moment in every session. Each individual success is an opportunity for a group celebration. 

Come join us for weekly drop in!

events.title: Wise Guyz
events.facility_name: The Nest – Fernwood Neighbourhood House (1240 Gladstone Avenue)
events.description: Hey guys, and people who support them! I’m Dustin – a youth counsellor in our community who is passionate about men’s mental health. I’m going to be honest with you, being a young man was a hard time for me. It seemed the world was yelling at me to toughen up while I was struggling with my mental health. The men around me taught me not to cry or talk about my feelings. This left me feeling really angry and alone. A few years after graduation I started to hear other men felt this way growing up, maybe you are one of these guys. You deserve so much better, so I’ve teamed up with Fernwood Neighbourhood Place to launch WiseGuyz, a judgement-free group for teenage guys to talk about their lives, build community, and feel seen. It’s a place to have conversations about real things in our lives like mental health, sex, love, relationships, and how we show up in the world. Plus, plenty of time to chill and eat snacks and play games. If this sounds like your vibe or you’re even a little bit curious, I’d love for you to pop by! If you have any questions or want to chat, please text me at (250) 415-4229.  Dates: Weekly on Wednesdays Time: 3:30pm – 4:30pm Duration: October 7 – February 17 Where: The Nest – Fernwood Neighbourhood House (1240 Gladstone Avenue)  Who: Teenage guys (13-16) Type: Fernwood NH Program Registration required, Free

events.title: Play Beyond Expectations
events.description:
Run by Lifetime Networks - Play Beyond Expectations provides adults with developmental disabilities an opportunity to access inclusive, community-based recreation in an open gym format. This group is  a fun and relaxed opportunity to learn different sports and social skills in an environment that welcomes young adults of all levels of functioning ability. Previous experience with sports is not required. This program focusses on enjoyable skill games based on floor hockey, basketball, pickleball and group games tailored to each person’s abilities.

Players and volunteers all enjoy the accepting and encouraging atmosphere. The lead volunteers are themselves people who have overcome physical challenges to find success in sports and in life. The improved physical activity, coordination, and cooperation skills gained in the gym transfer to greater success in other activities at home and in the community. Each participant is recognized for their best moment in every session. Each individual success is an opportunity for a group celebration. 

Come join us for weekly drop in!

events.title: Wise Guyz
events.facility_name: The Nest – Fernwood Neighbourhood House (1240 Gladstone Avenue)
events.description: Hey guys, and people who support them! I’m Dustin – a youth counsellor in our community who is passionate about men’s mental health. I’m going to be honest with you, being a young man was a hard time for me. It seemed the world was yelling at me to toughen up while I was struggling with my mental health. The men around me taught me not to cry or talk about my feelings. This left me feeling really angry and alone. A few years after graduation I started to hear other men felt this way growing up, maybe you are one of these guys. You deserve so much better, so I’ve teamed up with Fernwood Neighbourhood Place to launch WiseGuyz, a judgement-free group for teenage guys to talk about their lives, build community, and feel seen. It’s a place to have conversations about real things in our lives like mental health, sex, love, relationships, and how we show up in the world. Plus, plenty of time to chill and eat snacks and play games. If this sounds like your vibe or you’re even a little bit curious, I’d love for you to pop by! If you have any questions or want to chat, please text me at (250) 415-4229.  Dates: Weekly on Wednesdays Time: 3:30pm – 4:30pm Duration: October 7 – February 17 Where: The Nest – Fernwood Neighbourhood House (1240 Gladstone Avenue)  Who: Teenage guys (13-16) Type: Fernwood NH Program Registration required, Free

events.title: Friday Night Social 10-17yrs - Pool Tournament
events.description: Looking for a fun way to kick off your weekend? Swing by our supervised Friday Night Social Drop-In at Gordon Head Recreation Centre—a free, casual hangout where you can chill with friends, meet new people, and dive into a variety of awesome activities. Each week has different staff-led activities. Whether you’re into pool, ping pong, or testing your skills at arcade basketball, we’ve got you covered. Game lovers can compete on the PS5 gaming system, or challenge our staff to board games and card games for some friendly competition. Feeling creative? Try your hand at bracelet making or other fun arts and crafts projects. Plus, we’ll fuel the night with a tasty dinner, so you can relax, hang out, and enjoy great food while making memories.No sign-up needed—just drop in whenever you want for a night full of games, food, and good vibes!Closed on stat holidays and Pro D Days. Must be at least 10 years old and in grade 5 to attend this program.

events.title: Wise Guyz
events.facility_name: The Nest – Fernwood Neighbourhood House (1240 Gladstone Avenue)
events.description: Hey guys, and people who support them! I’m Dustin – a youth counsellor in our community who is passionate about men’s mental health. I’m going to be honest with you, being a young man was a hard time for me. It seemed the world was yelling at me to toughen up while I was struggling with my mental health. The men around me taught me not to cry or talk about my feelings. This left me feeling really angry and alone. A few years after graduation I started to hear other men felt this way growing up, maybe you are one of these guys. You deserve so much better, so I’ve teamed up with Fernwood Neighbourhood Place to launch WiseGuyz, a judgement-free group for teenage guys to talk about their lives, build community, and feel seen. It’s a place to have conversations about real things in our lives like mental health, sex, love, relationships, and how we show up in the world. Plus, plenty of time to chill and eat snacks and play games. If this sounds like your vibe or you’re even a little bit curious, I’d love for you to pop by! If you have any questions or want to chat, please text me at (250) 415-4229.  Dates: Weekly on Wednesdays Time: 3:30pm – 4:30pm Duration: October 7 – February 17 Where: The Nest – Fernwood Neighbourhood House (1240 Gladstone Avenue)  Who: Teenage guys (13-16) Type: Fernwood NH Program Registration required, Free

events.title: Wise Guyz
events.facility_name: The Nest – Fernwood Neighbourhood House (1240 Gladstone Avenue)
events.description: Hey guys, and people who support them! I’m Dustin – a youth counsellor in our community who is passionate about men’s mental health. I’m going to be honest with you, being a young man was a hard time for me. It seemed the world was yelling at me to toughen up while I was struggling with my mental health. The men around me taught me not to cry or talk about my feelings. This left me feeling really angry and alone. A few years after graduation I started to hear other men felt this way growing up, maybe you are one of these guys. You deserve so much better, so I’ve teamed up with Fernwood Neighbourhood Place to launch WiseGuyz, a judgement-free group for teenage guys to talk about their lives, build community, and feel seen. It’s a place to have conversations about real things in our lives like mental health, sex, love, relationships, and how we show up in the world. Plus, plenty of time to chill and eat snacks and play games. If this sounds like your vibe or you’re even a little bit curious, I’d love for you to pop by! If you have any questions or want to chat, please text me at (250) 415-4229.  Dates: Weekly on Wednesdays Time: 3:30pm – 4:30pm Duration: October 7 – February 17 Where: The Nest – Fernwood Neighbourhood House (1240 Gladstone Avenue)  Who: Teenage guys (13-16) Type: Fernwood NH Program Registration required, Free

events.title: Wise Guyz
events.facility_name: The Nest – Fernwood Neighbourhood House (1240 Gladstone Avenue)
events.description: Hey guys, and people who support them! I’m Dustin – a youth counsellor in our community who is passionate about men’s mental health. I’m going to be honest with you, being a young man was a hard time for me. It seemed the world was yelling at me to toughen up while I was struggling with my mental health. The men around me taught me not to cry or talk about my feelings. This left me feeling really angry and alone. A few years after graduation I started to hear other men felt this way growing up, maybe you are one of these guys. You deserve so much better, so I’ve teamed up with Fernwood Neighbourhood Place to launch WiseGuyz, a judgement-free group for teenage guys to talk about their lives, build community, and feel seen. It’s a place to have conversations about real things in our lives like mental health, sex, love, relationships, and how we show up in the world. Plus, plenty of time to chill and eat snacks and play games. If this sounds like your vibe or you’re even a little bit curious, I’d love for you to pop by! If you have any questions or want to chat, please text me at (250) 415-4229.  Dates: Weekly on Wednesdays Time: 3:30pm – 4:30pm Duration: October 7 – February 17 Where: The Nest – Fernwood Neighbourhood House (1240 Gladstone Avenue)  Who: Teenage guys (13-16) Type: Fernwood NH Program Registration required, Free

events.title: Wise Guyz
events.facility_name: The Nest – Fernwood Neighbourhood House (1240 Gladstone Avenue)
events.description: Hey guys, and people who support them! I’m Dustin – a youth counsellor in our community who is passionate about men’s mental health. I’m going to be honest with you, being a young man was a hard time for me. It seemed the world was yelling at me to toughen up while I was struggling with my mental health. The men around me taught me not to cry or talk about my feelings. This left me feeling really angry and alone. A few years after graduation I started to hear other men felt this way growing up, maybe you are one of these guys. You deserve so much better, so I’ve teamed up with Fernwood Neighbourhood Place to launch WiseGuyz, a judgement-free group for teenage guys to talk about their lives, build community, and feel seen. It’s a place to have conversations about real things in our lives like mental health, sex, love, relationships, and how we show up in the world. Plus, plenty of time to chill and eat snacks and play games. If this sounds like your vibe or you’re even a little bit curious, I’d love for you to pop by! If you have any questions or want to chat, please text me at (250) 415-4229.  Dates: Weekly on Wednesdays Time: 3:30pm – 4:30pm Duration: October 7 – February 17 Where: The Nest – Fernwood Neighbourhood House (1240 Gladstone Avenue)  Who: Teenage guys (13-16) Type: Fernwood NH Program Registration required, Free

events.title: Wise Guyz
events.facility_name: The Nest – Fernwood Neighbourhood House (1240 Gladstone Avenue)
events.description: Hey guys, and people who support them! I’m Dustin – a youth counsellor in our community who is passionate about men’s mental health. I’m going to be honest with you, being a young man was a hard time for me. It seemed the world was yelling at me to toughen up while I was struggling with my mental health. The men around me taught me not to cry or talk about my feelings. This left me feeling really angry and alone. A few years after graduation I started to hear other men felt this way growing up, maybe you are one of these guys. You deserve so much better, so I’ve teamed up with Fernwood Neighbourhood Place to launch WiseGuyz, a judgement-free group for teenage guys to talk about their lives, build community, and feel seen. It’s a place to have conversations about real things in our lives like mental health, sex, love, relationships, and how we show up in the world. Plus, plenty of time to chill and eat snacks and play games. If this sounds like your vibe or you’re even a little bit curious, I’d love for you to pop by! If you have any questions or want to chat, please text me at (250) 415-4229.  Dates: Weekly on Wednesdays Time: 3:30pm – 4:30pm Duration: October 7 – February 17 Where: The Nest – Fernwood Neighbourhood House (1240 Gladstone Avenue)  Who: Teenage guys (13-16) Type: Fernwood NH Program Registration required, Free

Party Fee Information:
~ Includes admission for up to 15 children and five adults
~ Children under 7 must be within arms reach of an adult (16+) at a 1:3 ratio in pool
~ Children 7-9 must have a responsible adult in the facility
~ Rental includes tables and chairs set up in party room
~ Rental insurance is required for a fee ranging $4-13. Visit crd.instantriskcoverage.com for purchase, select Birthday Party as the activity.

events.title: Wise Guyz
events.facility_name: The Nest – Fernwood Neighbourhood House (1240 Gladstone Avenue)
events.description: Hey guys, and people who support them! I’m Dustin – a youth counsellor in our community who is passionate about men’s mental health. I’m going to be honest with you, being a young man was a hard time for me. It seemed the world was yelling at me to toughen up while I was struggling with my mental health. The men around me taught me not to cry or talk about my feelings. This left me feeling really angry and alone. A few years after graduation I started to hear other men felt this way growing up, maybe you are one of these guys. You deserve so much better, so I’ve teamed up with Fernwood Neighbourhood Place to launch WiseGuyz, a judgement-free group for teenage guys to talk about their lives, build community, and feel seen. It’s a place to have conversations about real things in our lives like mental health, sex, love, relationships, and how we show up in the world. Plus, plenty of time to chill and eat snacks and play games. If this sounds like your vibe or you’re even a little bit curious, I’d love for you to pop by! If you have any questions or want to chat, please text me at (250) 415-4229.  Dates: Weekly on Wednesdays Time: 3:30pm – 4:30pm Duration: October 7 – February 17 Where: The Nest – Fernwood Neighbourhood House (1240 Gladstone Avenue)  Who: Teenage guys (13-16) Type: Fernwood NH Program Registration required, Free

events.title: Wise Guyz
events.facility_name: The Nest – Fernwood Neighbourhood House (1240 Gladstone Avenue)
events.description: Hey guys, and people who support them! I’m Dustin – a youth counsellor in our community who is passionate about men’s mental health. I’m going to be honest with you, being a young man was a hard time for me. It seemed the world was yelling at me to toughen up while I was struggling with my mental health. The men around me taught me not to cry or talk about my feelings. This left me feeling really angry and alone. A few years after graduation I started to hear other men felt this way growing up, maybe you are one of these guys. You deserve so much better, so I’ve teamed up with Fernwood Neighbourhood Place to launch WiseGuyz, a judgement-free group for teenage guys to talk about their lives, build community, and feel seen. It’s a place to have conversations about real things in our lives like mental health, sex, love, relationships, and how we show up in the world. Plus, plenty of time to chill and eat snacks and play games. If this sounds like your vibe or you’re even a little bit curious, I’d love for you to pop by! If you have any questions or want to chat, please text me at (250) 415-4229.  Dates: Weekly on Wednesdays Time: 3:30pm – 4:30pm Duration: October 7 – February 17 Where: The Nest – Fernwood Neighbourhood House (1240 Gladstone Avenue)  Who: Teenage guys (13-16) Type: Fernwood NH Program Registration required, Free

events.title: Wise Guyz
events.facility_name: The Nest – Fernwood Neighbourhood House (1240 Gladstone Avenue)
events.description: Hey guys, and people who support them! I’m Dustin – a youth counsellor in our community who is passionate about men’s mental health. I’m going to be honest with you, being a young man was a hard time for me. It seemed the world was yelling at me to toughen up while I was struggling with my mental health. The men around me taught me not to cry or talk about my feelings. This left me feeling really angry and alone. A few years after graduation I started to hear other men felt this way growing up, maybe you are one of these guys. You deserve so much better, so I’ve teamed up with Fernwood Neighbourhood Place to launch WiseGuyz, a judgement-free group for teenage guys to talk about their lives, build community, and feel seen. It’s a place to have conversations about real things in our lives like mental health, sex, love, relationships, and how we show up in the world. Plus, plenty of time to chill and eat snacks and play games. If this sounds like your vibe or you’re even a little bit curious, I’d love for you to pop by! If you have any questions or want to chat, please text me at (250) 415-4229.  Dates: Weekly on Wednesdays Time: 3:30pm – 4:30pm Duration: October 7 – February 17 Where: The Nest – Fernwood Neighbourhood House (1240 Gladstone Avenue)  Who: Teenage guys (13-16) Type: Fernwood NH Program Registration required, Free
